title: Cluster 03 DRILL: Biodiversity, Food Supply and Disease Spread
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 8, Extension Topic B · 9 questions · 91 marks · 32 parts · one mark per minute, so a little over an hour and a half · every question is an actual exam paper question

One primary concept each, checked for duplicated required answers as well as duplicated labels. Q1 reading a box plot at the granularity the scheme demands, and why the tropics lose more · Q2 a temperature shift applied to a banded mountain, and the range contraction that follows · Q3 a crop's temperature window against a country's temperature range · Q4 phenological mismatch as a crop problem, and why headline yield is the wrong measure · Q5 the LO (e) discuss across three required categories · Q6 the mosquito life cycle end to end, up the curve and over the top · Q7 the outcome's own words, beyond the tropics, plus a non-climate driver · Q8 the evaluate essay, agree then bound · Q9 stomata, net carbon gain and C3 against C4.

The two deliberately shared marking points, declared. First, tropical species already sit close to their tolerance limit, so a given warming pushes more of them past it, which Q1(b) needs as its whole answer and Q2(c) needs as the first of three points; Q1(b) is marked on the comparison across biomes and Q2(c) on the consequence for biomedicine production. Second, stomata close under water stress, so less CO2 reaches carbon fixation, which Q2(b) needs as one of five points, Q5 needs as one of seven, and Q9(a) needs as its whole answer with quoted values; the three are marked on the range shift, on breadth across food-supply categories, and on data quoting respectively. Every other required answer in the set is unique.

Nothing from Book 9, and nothing from Cluster 1 or Cluster 2. Dengue virology, the four serotypes and the host immune response belong to Extension Topic A and the school's own concept map marks them out of the 9477 syllabus for Book 8. Bluetongue serotypes, restriction zones and reassortment are out; keep only the vector range-expansion mechanism. Carbon footprints, the greenhouse mechanism and mangroves are Clusters 1 and 2 and are assumed here rather than retested.
